name: @bongtu/treasury-web
description: bongtu public wallet PoC — a self-custody wallet (SPEC §7 public app): connect any installed extension (EIP-6963) or WalletConnect through the RainbowKit modal (wagmi v2 + viem), derive a BabyJubJub spending key from an eth_signTypedData_v4 signature over a domain-separated struct (deterministic), show balance from the arbiter indexer (signed /notes), and assemble + prove + submit transfer / withdraw. Imports unbuilt @bongtu/* workspace source directly so the crypto is byte-identical.
